# rsomics-shapiro

The unchanged `src/swilk.rs` module from rsomics-shapiro 0.1.1 is included here
as `src/lib.rs`. CenAlert uses its `swilk` function; the upstream CLI and I/O
dependencies are omitted.

Upstream: https://github.com/omics-rust/rsomics-shapiro

Source archive SHA-256:
`3afa41f85a9f3a08bae35517c25e38b6983e453a1f9d9456b8e73c2d2c7008c3`.

The upstream package declares `MIT OR Apache-2.0`; this copy uses the MIT option.
